performance.verdict: Spend halved, CPL improved — but pipeline shows zero won opps and 3 overdue SOW milestones block scoreboard trust.

findings.text: Phone-match attribution gap (due 2026-08-07) is overdue; leads cannot be traced to appointments without it, breaking the August scoreboard.
Sync items + contact cleanup (due 2026-08-14) overdue; 263 GHL contacts but 0 won opps and 0 appointments recorded — intake visibility is broken.
CPL dropped 28.38% as spend fell 50.89% — last 3 days (Aug 17–19) average $28.32/day spend vs $43.20 prior 3 days, generating 5 leads vs 10: efficiency held but volume is shrinking fast.
GBP actions fell 38.46% last 7 days; last 3 days (Aug 17–19) show 0 actions each vs 25 on Aug 14 — organic referral to the site is collapsing alongside paid pullback.
83 GHL opps created over 28 days against 122 Meta leads, yet 0 appointments and 0 won opps recorded — leads are arriving but not converting inside GHL, signalling an intake leak not an ads problem.

suggestions.text: Close phone-match attribution gap immediately; without it, 122 leads and 83 opps cannot be tied to scheduled patients.
suggestions.monday_update: The phone-match attribution gap milestone was due 2026-08-07 and remains open. Without it, none of the 122 Meta leads over 28 days can be traced to booked appointments, which directly breaks the August scoreboard the client is using to decide renewal. Complete the attribution linkage this week. Success check: at least one confirmed lead-to-appointment trace visible in the dashboard by 2026-08-23.

suggestions.text: Complete GHL sync + contact cleanup; 83 opps created, 0 won, 0 appointments — intake pipeline is blind, not broken ads.
suggestions.monday_update: The sync items and contact cleanup milestone was due 2026-08-14 and is still open. GHL shows 83 opportunities created from 122 leads over 28 days but records 0 appointments and 0 won opps, indicating the pipeline is not capturing downstream movement. Completing the cleanup will reveal whether leads are being worked or silently dropped. Success check: at least 1 appointment reflected in GHL by 2026-08-25.

suggestions.text: Watch Meta daily spend: if 3-day average stays below $25/day by Aug 23, assess a modest budget lift to protect lead volume.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta spend averaged $28.32/day over the last 3 days (Aug 17–19), down from $43.20 the prior 3 days, and leads fell from 10 to 5 over the same window. CPL efficiency is holding, but volume risk is rising. Re-check on 2026-08-23: if the 3-day average drops below $25/day with no CPL improvement, bring a budget-lift recommendation to Sohib at that point.
